gfx1150.name: AMD Radeon 890M "Strix Point" (gfx1150)
gfx1150.provenance: bw and layer_us fitted on a Strix Point laptop (2x DDR5-5600, 61 GiB RAM) over a 6-point context sweep of Qwen3-0.6B-Q4_K_M and Qwen3.5-0.8B-Q4_K_M with calibrate_device.py (RMS 4%); weights and KV read at the same rate within 2%. flops is 16/40 of the gfx1151 rate: same RDNA3.5 CU, 16 of them. It is corroborated rather than assumed - measured prefill reaches 0.21 of it here and 0.20 of the gfx1151 figure on the same model (reference/calibration.md).
